name: Exosome Facials
title: Exosome Facials in Tustin | OC Concierge Doctor
description: Exosome facials in Tustin with Tariq A. Khan, MD, for texture, pores, tone, fine lines and scarring. Can be combined with microneedling, RF, peels and laser.
h1: Skin renewal, from the inside out.
lede: Exosomes are tiny messengers that cells use to communicate. Applied with microneedling or other treatments, they are used to support collagen and healing, with results that build over weeks and months.
glance: An add-on that pairs exosomes with microneedling, peels or laser for skin renewal.

signs.heading: What it addresses
signs.intro: Exosome facials suit any skin type and are often added to another skin treatment.

basics.heading: What exosomes are
paras: Exosomes are microscopic vesicles released by cells. They carry proteins, growth factors and genetic signals from one cell to another. Researchers are studying how these signals may reduce inflammation and support tissue repair.

The exosomes Dr. Khan uses come from donated, screened human mesenchymal stem cells. They contain no living cells. In an exosome facial, they are applied right after a treatment that opens channels in the skin, such as microneedling.

faq: No exosome product is FDA-approved to treat a medical condition. Dr. Khan uses exosomes as a complement to proven skin treatments and discusses what to expect with you.
Improvement builds over weeks and months and can last a long time with good skin care. Results vary by person.
It depends on the treatment it is paired with. Exosomes themselves add little to no downtime.
